verdicts.reason: A: the big opening quote mark is now a tiny glyph floating above the text, the attribution is spaced out and nearly as heavy as the quote (hierarchy inverted), the one-line quote is small and the 'GALLERY' tag looks garbled; the left margin and logo spacing still work, though. B has the same tiny quote mark and oversized attribution, plus the whole text block is pushed right, leaving a big empty area on the left, and the quote's last word 'move.' runs straight into the 'MONOGRAPH' wordmark, a clear collision.
